title: security: rbac v2 + KMS region residency + audit logging enhancements
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Enhances RBAC v2 to enforce KMS region residency constraints and improves audit logging for cross-region key access. Backwards-compatible policy defaults preserved; admins can opt-in to enforcement.
description:
Motivation: customers in regulated industries require stronger controls tying KMS key usage and model/data residency to RBAC policies and producing clearer audit trails for region-crossing operations. This change set strengthens RBAC v2 by adding explicit KMS region residency checks, improves audit logging for KMS and policy evaluation paths, and exposes a feature flag for enforcement.

What this PR does: - Adds a KMS residency policy predicate (rbac.predicate.kms_region) that can be attached to resource bindings to ensure KMS keys and workload regions align. - Adds audit log fields for audit.v2.kms_access with explicit region, key_id, requester_principal, and policy_evaluation_result. - Introduces an admin-configurable enforcement feature flag: rbac.v2.kms_residency_enforcement (default: audit-only). - Adds Linear tickets references and rollout plan in the description for visibility.

Design notes: - Predicate lives in the RBAC evaluation pipeline before granting secrets.io and kms.use actions. When enforcement is enabled, requests that violate region residency are denied with a clear error code (RBAC_KMS_REGION_VIOLATION). In audit-only mode, incidents are logged but not blocked. - Audit logs are emitted to the existing audit sink with a new structured message and context tags so downstream SIEM and Data Residency systems can filter by region and key. - Backwards compatibility: existing policies without the predicate behave as today. Default behavior is audit-only to avoid unexpected breakage. Admins can migrate via the provided Linear task and a one-click console toggle.

Testing and verification: - Unit tests for predicate logic and policy evaluation added (rbac/predicates/kms_region_test.go). - Integration tests cover cross-region key access simulation under audit-only and enforcement modes (slo-toolkit/integration/rbac_kms_residency_test.py). - E2E staging validated with a sample Private deployment using a mock KMS that returns region metadata. - CI: lint, unit, integration, and end-to-end tests passed on green.

Rollout plan: - Merge to main in audit-only mode. - Notify customers via change log and console banner. - Monitor audit metrics (rbac.kms_region.violation.count) and engage customers who have violations. - After 30 days of monitoring and no major regressions, enable enforcement for platform-managed tenants and offer guidance for self-managed tenants.

Docs and migration: - Console docs updated with examples and UI screenshots (redwood-docs/content/security/kms-region-residency.md). - Admin migration checklist included in the release notes.

Related: ENG-8421, SEC-412, SUP-1298.
